speaker: Unknown

en: And then above that is the most important layer and the layer that I care most about that our country takes advantage of is the application layer.

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is, you know, applications for legal services, for health services, for manufacturing, so on and so forth.

speaker: Unknown
en: Every single industry is involved.
zh: 每一个行业都涉及其中。

en: And that's the magical thing.

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the question is, from that,

en: The purpose of the software engineer is engineer.

en: There was engineering before software.

en: And so that mission, that purpose doesn't change.
zh: 所以那个使命,那个目的不会改变。

speaker: Unknown

en: We didn't have benefits of software engineering.
zh: 我们没有软件工程带来的好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't have the benefits of coding.
zh: 我们没有编程带来的好处。

en: But our jobs existed before, and if software coding was to be completely automated, our jobs would exist again.
zh: 但我们的工作在当时就存在，而如果软件编程被完全自动化，我们的工作会再次存在。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think the fallacy, and now it's, you know, because of some of the narratives and some of the storytelling has turned into myth, and it's harmful, is that AI will destroy jobs, which is fundamentally wrong.
zh: 所以我认为这个谬论——你知道，因为一些叙事和一些讲故事，它已经变成了神话，而且是有害的——就是 AI 会摧毁工作，这从根本上是错误的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will change every job.

speaker: Unknown
en: It'll change every job.

en: Some jobs where the job and the task is really one, meaning customer service on the phone, in a lot of cases, that job is precisely

en: The task.

en: And so in those cases, it could be automated away.

en: Previous to that, we spent 15 years trying to make it work.
zh: 在那之前，我们花了 15 年时间努力让它能工作。

en: One day, I had to pump gas, and it was a few years ago, and they needed my zip code.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't know my zip code.

en: I don't know my telephone number, but I forget these things.

speaker: Unknown
en: I can live with it.
zh: 我可以忍受这个。

en: But let me take the other side because I don't want to fall into a thing where because some skills can be safely offloaded, I also can't get anywhere without a mapping system now.

en: There is, prior to AI here we're talking, a lot of concern and noticing among college professors and others that the way people use the internet has probably shortened attention spans.

en: Today's engineers are far better systems thinkers than I was when I graduated from school, but I was a much better transistor thinker.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你知道,现在大多数工程师的工作远在晶体管之上,远在具体功能之上,他们把东西拼凑在一起来做事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you need to think much more about systems and interactions of systems.

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我真的不知道那有多重要,但它对某些人是重要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The consumer of technology don't have to deal with calculus and physics and quantum physics and quantum chemistry.
zh: 技术的消费者不必去应付微积分、物理、量子物理和量子化学。

speaker: Unknown
en: The users, which is, you know, the people we're talking about right now, the people whose jobs are affected, they're the users of the technology.
zh: 而用户,你知道,就是我们现在正在谈论的人,那些工作受到影响的人,他们是技术的用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: Their abstraction is going to be much higher.
zh: 他们的抽象层级会高得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I want to drop a layer down your cake to the models.
zh: 所以我想往下深入你蛋糕的一层,谈谈模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So people, I think, to the extent they think about models, they know, you know, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok.
zh: 说到人们,我想,就他们对模型的认知而言,他们知道,你知道,ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok。

en: You've been a big advocate for open models and the open model ecosystem.
zh: 你一直是开放模型和开放模型生态的大力倡导者。

zh: 那么，首先，你能描述一下什么是开放模型，什么是开放权重模型吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then why that's been a place you've focused.
zh: 然后为什么这一直是你们专注的领域。

en: So closed models is like any software product.

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a closed service.

speaker: Unknown
en: And so Windows, for example, is a closed service.
zh: 而因为它是基础设施，对许多公司、非常非常多的公司和国家而言，你需要对自己的基础设施拥有控制权。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 所以这些是封闭产品，从事这些工作的人非常出色，他们对此充满热情，并且处于我们所说的「前沿」，也就是说他们是 state of the art(最先进的)。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also need
zh: 我们还需要——

speaker: Unknown
en: Because fundamentally what the software is, it's an infrastructure layer for the entire industry.
zh: 因为从根本上说，这个软件是什么，它是整个行业的一个基础设施层。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because it's infrastructural for many companies and many, many companies and countries, you need to have control over your own infrastructure.
zh: 而且因为它对许多公司、非常非常多的公司和国家来说是基础设施，你需要对自己的基础设施拥有控制权。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 然后我需要对它拥有控制权，因为我有一家公司要经营，我不能依赖别人的服务。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 所以无论你怎么看待这件事，我认为这个世界既需要封闭模型也需要开放模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we need to make sure that both are vibrant.
zh: 而我们需要确保两者都充满活力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And today the closed models are vibrant, the open models are vibrant.
zh: 今天，封闭模型充满活力，开放模型也充满活力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you could see it, you could see the system working.
zh: 而且你可以看到，你可以看到这个系统在运转。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你知道，如果没有开源，中国的移动互联网和云行业真的不会腾飞。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is also the case that, you know, people move around, they start a lot of new companies, intellectual property is moving around China's industry really fluidly.
zh: 还有就是，你知道，人才流动，他们创办很多新公司，知识产权在中国的产业中流动得非常自由。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你知道，很难保守秘密。

zh: 所以出于这些原因，中国的开源模型、开放模型社区非常非常有活力。

speaker: Unknown

zh: Clem，Hugging Face 的 CEO，他们得出的结论是他们需要大得多的规模。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 就像我们刚才聊的，开放模型正在飞速飙升。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我觉得这对很多人来说挺震撼的。

en: Well, you gotta tease that apart.

zh: 首先，很多事情是同时发生的。

zh: 从技术角度来看，一个智能体——顺便说一句，它就是一段软件——

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is given an objective function and it comes up with a plan and it's optimizing towards that objective is what algorithms do.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: And as a result, we just didn't plan enough energy production.
zh: 结果，我们就是没有规划足够的能源生产。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you mean by gummed up there?

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of a sudden, this new industry comes along and we find ourselves in a situation where we just don't have that much energy building capacity.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's a lot of things you could do, but it's hard to do that, you know, after the fact.

zh: 如果你想要一个未来，如果你想在气候变化上迎来转机，如果你想要一个可持续的未来，那就拥抱 AI。

zh: 这是我们抵达那里所拥有的最好机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we need to build the energy faster to do that.
